title: 第109章 你还记得闻仲太师吗
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“杨戬。”

他喊出了那个天神的名字。

“你还记得商纣之战吗？”

“商纣之战”这四个字，通过扬声器，清晰地传到了指挥中心每一个人的耳朵里。

周玄策猛地瞪大了眼睛，他感觉自己的心脏像是被一只无形的大手给攥住了！

王斌这位办公厅副主任，更是直接“蹭”地一下从椅子上站了起来，脸上写满了不敢置信。

“商……商纣之战？是我想的那个商纣之战吗？《封神演义》里的那个？”

“不可能吧……那不是小说里编的吗……”楚嵩阳喃喃自语，眼神都直了。

整个指挥中心，瞬间炸开了锅！

如果说，之前看到神仙，看到法天象地，他们还能勉强用“高维生物”、“未知文明”来解释。

那么现在，“商纣之战”这四个字，就如同一把钥匙，彻底

那是华夏人刻在骨子里的记忆！是妇孺皆知的神话故事！

纣王、妲己、姜子牙、哪吒、杨戬……

那些只存在于书本和影视剧中的名字，在这一刻，仿佛都活了过来！

“安静！”

老天师猛地一拍桌子，发出“砰”的一声巨响，镇住了所有人的议论。

他的胸膛剧烈地起伏着，死死地盯着屏幕，一字一顿地说道：“不是小说！那不是小说！”

“道门典籍有载，那是一场真实发生过的，席卷了整个人间界和修行界的……仙人之战！是天道的一次重新洗牌！是决定了此后三千年人间格局的……封神之战！”

老天师的话，让所有人都倒吸了一口凉气。

他们看着屏幕上那个淡漠的身影，一个让他们自己都觉得荒谬绝伦的念头，不受控制地涌了上来。

难道……

这位顾前辈，他……

他参加过那场……三千年前的封神之战？

而就在所有人都被这个猜测震撼到无以复加的时候。

天空之上，那道原本正在迅速闭合的空间裂缝，猛地一顿。

它停住了。

仿佛有一股无形的力量，从裂缝的另一端传来，强行维持着它的存在。

紧接着，那个属于杨戬的，充满了惊怒和仓皇的声音，再一次，从天外传了回来。

只不过，这一次，他的声音里，再也没有了之前的傲慢和威严，只剩下一种无法掩饰的……颤抖。

“你……你怎么会知道……商纣之战？”

“你……你怎么会知道……商纣之战？”

杨戬那带着极度震惊和一丝恐惧的声音，从天外裂缝中传递下来，回荡在天地之间。

他跑了，但又没完全跑。

顾长青的第一个问题，就像是一只无形的手，跨越了无尽的时空，死死地抓住了他，让他根本无法真正离开。

749局指挥中心里，所有人都被这戏剧性的一幕给搞蒙了。

“他停下了？那个神……他竟然停下了？”楚嵩阳指着屏幕，结结巴巴地说道。

“不是停下了。”老天师的眼睛亮得吓人，他死死地盯着屏幕，仿佛要将每一个细节都刻进脑子里，“他是……不敢走！”

“不敢走？”周玄策愣住了，“为什么？他不是已经怕得要死了吗？”

“因为‘商纣之战’这四个字！”老天师的声音因为激动而拔高了八度，“这四个字，对我们来说，可能只是一个神话故事！但对他们这些亲身经历者来说，那是一段被封禁的禁忌历史！是不能被提起的过去！”

“顾前辈当着他的面，提起了这段历史，这说明了什么？”老天师环视了一圈已经彻底傻掉的同僚，一字一顿地说道：“这说明，顾前辈不仅知道那段历史，而且，他在那段历史中的地位，高到足以让杨戬这样的天神，连逃跑的勇气都没有！”

这个解释，让周玄策等人感觉自己的大脑又一次宕机了。

地位高到让天界战神连逃跑都不敢？

这到底是什么样的地位？

圣人？道祖？还是……比那更高的存在？

他们已经完全不敢想象下去了。

此刻，他们唯一能做的，就是像个最普通的观众一样，看着屏幕上那两个正在进行着跨时空对话的“神”。

不，或许用“神”来形容顾长青，已经不合适了。

他更像是一个……审判神明的存在。

淮南上空。

顾长青对于杨戬的反应，没有丝毫意外。

他依旧抬着头，看着那道漆黑的裂缝，仿佛能穿透无尽的空间，看到裂缝背后那个惊恐万状的身影。

他的脸上，依旧是那副平淡的表情。

仿佛他问出的不是什么惊天秘闻，而只是在问一个老朋友：“你还记得我们上次一起吃饭是在哪家馆子吗？”

这种极致的平淡，和杨戬那极致的惊恐，形成了一种无比诡异，却又无比和谐的对比。

顾长青的内心，确实没什么波澜。

“商纣之战？闻仲太师？”

他的脑海里，闪过这两个刚刚从嘴里说出的名字。

说实话，他自己也是一知半解。

这些信息，并不是来自于他本身的记忆，而是在他刚才决定要彻底解决这个“麻烦”的时候，那个一直很安静的“仙门传承系统”，突然传递给他的一段信息碎片。

系统似乎是判断出，光靠武力威胁，可能无法一劳永逸。

这个叫杨戬的家伙，虽然跑了，但肯定会回去搬救兵。

到时候，来的可能就不是一个杨戬，而是一群杨戬了。

虽然顾长青不觉得自己会怕，但……真的很烦。

他只想安安静静地待着，不希望总有苍蝇在耳边嗡嗡叫。

于是，系统便给出了一个“一劳永逸”的解决方案。

那就是，通过特定的“关键词”，唤醒对方深层记忆中的某个“锚点”，从而在心理层面，彻底击溃对方，建立起绝对的，不可动摇的威慑。

“商纣之战”是第一个关键词。

现在看来，效果拔群。

那么，接下来，就是第二个了。

顾长青看着天空，在全世界数十亿人的注视下，在749局所有人的紧张聆听中，在杨戬那惊疑不定的等待中，缓缓地，问出了第二个问题。

“那你，还记得闻仲太师吗？”

"Yang Jian."

He called out the name of the god.

"Do you still remember the battle between Shang and Zhou?"

The four words "War of Shang and Zhou" were clearly transmitted to the ears of everyone in the command center through the loudspeakers.

Zhou Xuance's eyes widened suddenly, and he felt as if his heart was being grasped by a big invisible hand!

Wang Bin, the deputy director of the general office, stood up from his chair with a sudden movement, his face full of disbelief.

"Shang... The battle between Shang and Zhou? Is it the battle between Shang and Zhou that I thought of? The one in "The Romance of the Gods"?"

"It's impossible... isn't that made up in the novel..." Chu Songyang murmured to himself, his eyes straightened.

The entire command center exploded instantly!

If they saw gods, heaven and earth before, they could barely explain it with "high-dimensional creatures" and "unknown civilization".

So now, these four words "War of Shang and Zhou" are like a key, completely

That is the memory engraved in the bones of the Chinese people!It is a fairy tale known to all women and children!

King Zhou, Daji, Jiang Ziya, Nezha, Yang Jian...

Those names that only existed in books and movies and TV series seemed to come alive at this moment!

"Quiet!"

The old Heavenly Master slammed the table with a loud bang, silencing everyone's discussion.

His chest heaved violently, he stared at the screen and said word by word: "That's not a novel! That's not a novel!"

"It is recorded in the Taoist classics. It was a real event that swept the entire human world and the spiritual world...the Immortal War! It was a reshuffling of the way of heaven! It was the... Battle of the Gods that determined the pattern of the human world for the next three thousand years!"

The Heavenly Master's words made everyone take a breath of cold air.

They looked at the indifferent figure on the screen, and an idea that made them feel ridiculous came to them uncontrollably.

Could it be...

This Senior Gu, he...

He participated in that... Battle of the Gods three thousand years ago?

And just when everyone was shocked beyond measure by this speculation.

Above the sky, the space crack that was closing rapidly suddenly stopped.

It stopped.

It was as if there was an invisible force coming from the other side of the crack, forcibly maintaining its existence.

Immediately afterwards, the voice belonging to Yang Jian, full of shock, anger and panic, came back from the sky again.

However, this time, there was no longer the arrogance and majesty in his voice, only an unconcealable... trembling.

"You...how do you know...the battle between Shang and Zhou?"

"You...how do you know...the battle between Shang and Zhou?"

Yang Jian's voice, filled with extreme shock and a hint of fear, came down from the cracks outside the sky and echoed between heaven and earth.

He ran, but not quite.

Gu Changqing's first question was like an invisible hand that spanned endless time and space and grabbed him tightly, making it impossible for him to really leave.

Everyone in the 749th Bureau command center was confused by this dramatic scene.

"He stopped? That god...he actually stopped?" Chu Songyang pointed at the screen and stammered.

"It's not stopping." The old master's eyes were frighteningly bright. He stared at the screen, as if he wanted to carve every detail into his mind, "He... doesn't dare to leave!"

"Don't dare to leave?" Zhou Xuance was stunned, "Why? Isn't he already scared to death?"

"Because of these four words, 'War of Shang and Zhou'!" The old master's voice rose an octave due to excitement. "These four words, to us, may be just a mythical story! But to those who have experienced it personally, it is a forbidden and taboo history! It is a past that cannot be mentioned!"

"Senior Gu mentioned this period of history in front of him. What does this mean?" The old Heavenly Master looked around at his colleagues who had been completely stunned and said word by word: "This shows that Senior Gu not only knows that period of history, but also that his status in that period of history is high enough that a god like Yang Jian doesn't even have the courage to escape!"

This explanation made Zhou Xuance and others feel that their brains had shut down again.

His status is so high that the God of War in the Heavenly Realm doesn't even dare to escape?

What kind of status is this?

saint?Daozu?Or...a higher being than that?

They couldn't imagine it anymore.

At this moment, the only thing they can do is to look at the two "gods" on the screen who are having a conversation across time and space like the most ordinary audience.

No, maybe using "god" to describe Gu Changqing is no longer appropriate.

He is more like a... judgmental god.

Over Huainan.

Gu Changqing was not surprised at all by Yang Jian's reaction.

He still raised his head, looking at the dark crack, which seemed to penetrate endless space, and saw the terrified figure behind the crack.

His face still had that plain expression.

It was as if what he was asking was not some shocking secret, but just asking an old friend: "Do you remember which restaurant we last had dinner at?"

This extreme calmness and Yang Jian's extreme panic formed an extremely strange, yet extremely harmonious contrast.

Gu Changqing's heart was indeed calm.

"The battle between Shang and Zhou? Master Wen Zhong?"

The two names that just came out of his mouth flashed in his mind.

To be honest, he himself didn't know much about it.

This information did not come from his own memory, but a fragment of information that was suddenly transmitted to him by the always quiet "Immortal Sect Heritage System" when he just decided to completely solve this "trouble".

The system seems to have judged that the threat of force alone may not solve the problem once and for all.

Although this guy named Yang Jian ran away, he would definitely go back to bring reinforcements.

By then, the person who comes may not be one Yang Jian, but a group of Yang Jian.

Although Gu Changqing didn't think he would be afraid, it was... really annoying.

He just wanted to stay quietly and didn't want flies buzzing in his ears all the time.

As a result, the system provides a "once and for all" solution.

That is, through specific "keywords", a certain "anchor point" in the opponent's deep memory is awakened, thereby completely defeating the opponent at the psychological level and establishing an absolute and unshakable deterrent.

"War between Shang and Zhou" is the first keyword.

Now it seems that the effect is outstanding.

So, next, is the second one.

Gu Changqing looked at the sky. Under the gaze of billions of people around the world, under the nervous listening of everyone in Bureau 749, and under Yang Jian's uncertain wait, he slowly asked his second question.

"Then you, do you still remember Grand Master Wen Zhong?"
